project_summary: Distributed World Simulator is developed through parallel domain programs under one canonical main-owned architecture and control ledger.

G.short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
G.purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
G.expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
G.progress_note: G8.1 Valley Incision Baseline is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on head 42940c0b7f16b2ccf3704d7e603691415b1360cf with G8.0 parent PASS, valley baseline PASS, geomorphology ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. G8.2 is now implemented as river-channel incision composed on the accepted G8.1 valley result using the same semantic bundle and profile. Inputs add accepted geo/river-distance-m and geo/river-width-m. Full channel width is interpreted as +/- half-width around the centerline: the core reaches river_max_depth_m, the outer river_edge_softness_ratio band fades cubically to zero, and at/beyond half-width river incision is zero. G8.2 preserves the exact valley component and adds only river_channel_delta_m; bank/floodplain/erosion-deposition remain zero. No SurfaceCellKey, LOD, Matter, authority, persistence, material or network ownership is introduced. Focused and full Windows validation are pending.
G.next_stage: Run RUN_G8_2_RIVER_CHANNEL_INCISION_TESTS.ps1 on exact Windows Godot 4.7.1 double. If green, without fetch/reset run RUN_G8_2_FULL_ACCEPTANCE.ps1 on the same clean checkout. Only a full PASS unlocks G8.3 Banks and Floodplain Shaping.

CH.expected_outcome: Equipped Item UUIDs survive server restart in the same canonical equipment slots; recovered authority continues accepting equip/unequip commands; reconnecting and late-joining clients converge and render exactly one presentation per equipped item.
CH.progress_note: CH9.4 is FOCUSED_ACCEPTED. Accepted runtime head e41c6ec46ae13c2244e92d47d891ecd345e746fe stages and validates the equipment-aware Item Graph before base transactional restore and reuses existing M6 persistence/replay/recovery unchanged. CH9.4 therefore preserves exact Item UUIDs, equipment slots, replay idempotency, reconnect ownership transition, late-join projection and successive checkpoint generations without duplicate canonical identities. Per PC0 policy, a post-acceptance audit is now mandatory before another CH stage is declared.

DOCTRINE.short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
DOCTRINE.purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
DOCTRINE.expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
DOCTRINE.progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
DOCTRINE.next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears

NX.expected_outcome: Network foundations remain reusable while tuning/fix branches can be registered as active frontiers when network work becomes primary again.
